findings.issue: The loop's variables live in a memory struct (vars.cachedUserCfg as mem[_6 + 96]), so the test becomes 'while True: if not mem[_6 + 96]: ... return'; and 'u and s / u' is the value-'and' of c00410 (s / u if u != 0 else 0).
findings.rule: Promote memory words written and read only by this function (a non-escaping memory struct) to named locals; then the loop test reads 'while cachedUserCfg != 0'. Print 'a and b' with non-boolean b as 'b if a else 0'.

findings.rule: Recognise the allocation loop without peeling; uint8(uint8(x) + 1) is uint8(x + 1).
